_about: Grasp profiles for the real arm. Search results: simulator/grasp_search_results/2026-11-22/. 'current' = the settings used up to 2026-11-22; 'sim_elite' = the best group of the simulator search (elite mean: lifted 11/13, placed 7/13 in the simulator). Values in metres / gripper units.

current.description: fixed jaw 4 mm clear of the block, tool point 8 mm below the block centre

sim_elite.description: simulator search, elite mean: opening 92, approach offset 23 mm, grasp height 28.7 mm (search hover 83 mm tool height; 70 mm used, it is easier to reach); search grasp_shift -11.6 mm is for placing and unused here; closing speed and settle time are not applied (the real closing stays slow)

centred.description: the middle between the open jaws is aimed at the block's centre (computed from the arm's model), with the wrist turned so the jaws close across the block's faces; opening 92, grasp height 28.7 mm
